environment.description: Flask application deployed on EC2 behind a standard AWS ALB with HTTP listener on port 443 (TLS termination at ALB with server certificate only). Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No WAF attached. Application runs as root in Docker container with host network mode.

config.alb_listener: HTTPS:443 with ACM server cert, no client cert validation
